title: Applicability of other laws.
bodyText: Nothing in this chapter shall be construed to relieve any corporation from compliance with or being subject to any other applicable law.
bodyHtml: [§421I-10]  Applicability of other laws.  Nothing in this chapter shall be construed to relieve any corporation from compliance with or being subject to any other applicable law. [L 1993, c 282, pt of §1]
